description: Readonly product-answer response vectors. Clone a base, then apply set paths or remove paths. Shape vectors are shared by Node, static browser and Python; cross-field semantic vectors remain shape-valid and are rejected by TypeScript owning consumers. Syntactic hashes are not cryptographic attestations, and resolved means source-location resolution, not claim review.

valid.name: available answer with native hash distinct from visible answer hash
unavailable answer has no mapping or native hash
resolved citation retains original PDF identity
exact text permits source line breaks
physical page can be final page

invalidShape.name: conversation is opaque id in response
conversation is opaque id in focus
unavailable answer cannot retain native hash
resolved focus exact text cannot be empty
original size must allow PDF signature
original filename is not a path
original must have PDF display name
locator position must use source scalar units

invalidSemantic.name: manifest summary must be computed from blocks
focus page must equal locator physical page
focus page must exist in original PDF
whitespace is not an exact text highlight
locator ratio geometry remains within page
